name: lingdt-decision-fast-1.0
description: LingDT-Decision (Ling version) is an in-house System One model developed by Ant Digital Technologies for decision-making tasks across the software development lifecycle. It addresses the fundamental mismatch between traditional large language models (LLMs) and decision workloads in efficiency, reliability, and cost. The model supports three common decision modes—choice (single-select), bool (binary judgment), and score (scoring)—along with native multi-select and information extraction capabilities. Its output confidence scores are carefully calibrated for greater reliability and trustworthiness. LingDT-Decision has been validated in industry AI applications across customer service, risk management, finance, and other domains.
zhDescription: 蚂蚁数科自研System One模型LingDT-Decision（Ling 版）， 主要用于各种软件研发过程的决策类型任务。能解决传统大语言模型（LLM）在效率、可靠性和成本上存在的根本性错配问题。目前LingDT-Decision模型支持choice（单选）、noul（判断）、score（打分）三种常见决策模式， 还原生支持多选和信息抽取功能。此外，模型在返回的置信度方面实现深度对齐，使得模型更加可靠、可信，目前LingDT-Decision已经在客服、风控、金融等多个产业AI场景应用验证。
